alex.headline: Yes, with a snack
alex.condition: Have 15 g of fast carbs first
alex.reason: Even without 30 min run, the model expects a low of about 58 tomorrow around 11:30 am, and 30 min run does not change that. If you have 15 g of fast carbs first, the low point rises to about 57. A better time would be tomorrow at 7:30 am.

priya.headline: Yes, with a snack
priya.condition: Eat a small snack (about 20 g of carbs) 15 minutes before
priya.reason: On its own, 30 min run would drop you to about 107 tomorrow around 11:30 am because exercise burns through sugar faster. If you eat a small snack (about 20 g of carbs) 15 minutes before, the low point becomes about 128 and a low is unlikely. A better time would be tomorrow at 9:00 am.
